claims.text: CoCoRaHS has come through several disruptions with its stored archive intact, but observations were lost in at least one: on 7 April 2011 a host firewall blocked the site from its database and the network ended up about 500 daily reports short after back-filling; on 9 April 2013 a power issue at the hosting company's data centre took the site down for at least 3 hours; in late 2013 the site was painfully slow for weeks; NCEI's daily CoCoRaHS updates were interrupted by a provider issue fixed on 1 December 2020. The site was up during the October 2013 and January 2019 federal shutdowns. Partly supports RRS-5.
